Project purpose and intended users
A controlled prototype for a complete assistance journey

text: The problem
A passenger needs a clear way to request help and know when boarding or alighting is safe.
textPreview: A passenger needs a clear way to request help and know when boarding or alighting is safe.

text: The proposed response
Connect an explicit request to acknowledgement, safety checks, automated assistance and verified completion.
textPreview: Connect an explicit request to acknowledgement, safety checks, automated assistance and verified completion.

text: Intended users
People using mobility aids and passengers who choose extra time or audio, visual or haptic guidance.
